name: Demoness
intro: The Demoness pathway combines agility, curses, poison, charm and catastrophic feminine transformation. It excels at control and punishing prolonged fights.

meter.name: Affliction
meter.full: Spread one curse to one other foe; cannot spread recursively
meter.quirkText: Combat-only curses, charm, poison and survival.

ability.name: Killing Point
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Killing Point — +12 percentage points critical chance; +25% Poison direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Instigation
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Instigation — Deals 120% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Psychic damage (22% base DEF bypass); 35% chance: Confused for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Witch's Curse
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Witch's Curse — Deals 130% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Poison damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Curse (3% Max HP Dark damage before each affected turn) for 2 turns; subject to status resistance and immunity; Curse ticks build a separate Affliction charge. From Sequence 5, At 100 charge, spread one existing curse to one other foe for 2 turns; spread cannot repeat itself.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Affliction Thread
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Affliction Thread — Deals 150% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy SPEED −20% for 2 turns; 100% chance: Bound (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; 100% chance: avoids targeting and incoming damage for 1 turn; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Mirror Substitution
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Mirror Substitution — Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; 100% chance: +40 percentage points Dodge for 1 turn; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Unaging Mirror Clone
ability.label: Active

ability.name: Despair Thread
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Despair Thread — Deals 230% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Elemental damage (22% base DEF bypass); resistance uses the average of Fire, Water, Lightning and Frost; 100% chance: Silenced for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 70 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Pestilence Realm
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Pestilence Realm — Targets all enemies; Deals 280% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Poison damage (22% base DEF bypass); 100% chance: Poison (5% Max HP Poison damage before each affected turn) for 2 turns; subject to status resistance and immunity; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: World Epidemic

ability.name: Abyss of Despair
